name: the-ford-probe
description: The Ford (spec §10): the preregistered readout of the channel network's three axes — H1 channel-land-fraction (interval [0.005%, 0.5%] of land AREA), H2 channel-connectivity (floor 0.95), H4 channel-band-monotonicity (floor 0.99). A probe, not a census: 64 consecutive worlds (seeds 0-63) under default pins, read on the three channel metrics plus channel-band-monotonicity-untruncated and channel-transect-dry-reach, which must be read over the SAME population monotonicity is, so the hypotheses are scored against a population rather than against the single world CHANNEL_WIDTH_COEFF was calibrated on. Seed 42 — the calibration world named in the spec — is inside the window, and so is seed 7, the second world Task 4's probes measured. Deliberately named outside the census convention; nothing it writes is committed.
